title: Appendix: for the Organiser
html:
Who this group is for: the event organiser (the facilitator, the event owner, or the customer's cloud platform administrator). Participants do not need it: they have no AWS access at all and only open the console address the organiser hands out, in a browser.

Chapter Contents Who
Organizer deployment guide Before the event, deploy the environment in every team's AWS account, check the models and the release policy, and hand out access; troubleshoot during the event; tear down afterwards The organiser, in the AWS console / CloudShell

The whole workshop runs in us-east-1 only, and every team needs its own AWS account.
